The layout of my skin is as follows: dry, sensitive, acne prone. What I CANT use: PGA, HA, AHA's, Niacinamide, Shea Butter. After thorough research, I bought this product. I've been using this product for exactly 22 days (April 6th 2025). Within these 22 days my skin had had a massive improvement with my acne. Skin texture is smoother and more even. HOWEVER, something in this product is irritating my lips horrendously. Within the past 22 days I've had 4 irritation bumps appear just on my lips. After the first one appeared on April 15th, I immediately scheduled a visit with my dermatologist fearing the bump was something more sinister. Everything sinister was ruled out. She stated that it was likely a fordyce spot or a bump from something irritating my lip. At the time, I didnt equate the bump to the moisturizer. It went away after 5 days. But then another one appeared just two days later and I was at a loss. Ive NEVER had any issues with my Lips. I couldnt understand why all of the sudden my lips looked like that. Terrified, i cautiously put on this moisturizer in the morning, avoiding my lips, and I havent had any appear for a week and a half. Yesterday, in a rush I applied this moisturizer and forgot to be careful around my lips. I woke up this morning with TWO bumps on my lips… unfortunately confirming that this product is the culprit of the bumps. I will be returning.

There has been something off with my skin though.It's flaking and dry, but I'm not sure if it had to do with the bubble. I think it might just be my skin overall. But my skin's been flaky and very dry. But it is a very good product and feels very hydrating on the skin.

I love this moisturizer. I had originally purchased the slam dunk moisturizer but felt it didn't match my skincare needs. I knew they had two other options for moisturizers and because they have, what I feel like is a great breakdown and explanation of each moisturizer, I was able to narrow it down to this one, the cloud surf. I have sensitive combo skin now (I used to have normal skin and didn't need any attention or fuss ) but just in the last two years I've been working on keeping my newly developed hormonal acne under control, so finding a good moisturizer was critical. I had high hopes for this one because for me it checked all my boxes: lightweight, unscented, no dyes, "clean", extremely affordable, AND there were over 500 reviews with overwhelmingly positive reactions to the product.. After trying it I found Cloud Surf to be lightweight, it absorbs well, it's easy to layer with my other products and I feel like it sufficiently moisturizes without clogging up my skin. I've been using these products for a little over a year now and I'm very happy. I actually just recently recommended a handful of these products to a friend of mine (along with a few others that I swear by) because she has sensitive skin and I genuinely think these products are worth trying. I know all people are different, all skin is different, everyone responds to things differently. But if you're looking for some new basic skincare products, products to create a simple routine or you want all the steps
